title: Help
author: United-Tour5043
selftext:
Can we make this sub more about ai game dev and less like a showcase board?

I love seeing what everyone is building, but dropping a video or an image with no context turns this community into a showcase rather than a space to collaborate.

We have a real opportunity to learn from one another. Instead of just showing the final result, let’s dig into the actual dev work: workflows, pipelines, prompts, challenges, and lessons learned along the way. Showing off a cool output is great; showing *how* you turned it into an actual game is ten times more valuable.
